generations.text: Hannah Mbeki contacted support because the Aero 2 stops charging after a few minutes since 2026-04-02. It is a Medium priority case and the status is currently Closed. The agent offered a credit of $575.00. The customer confirmed order ORD-92610 and asked for a replacement. The knowledge base notes that Aero 2 firmware 3.2 fixes the charging fault on the dock. The tone of the thread is polite but increasingly impatient.
